rationale: The workflow tests a local GitHub Action (check-latest-semver) by creating a temporary git repository with tags and running the action against it. It has no dependency installation (no npm, pip, Maven, etc.), no matrix, a single job, and executes only shell commands and a local composite action. The evidence patterns provided address dependency caching (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE, P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), custom timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), environment caching (P-LIT-ENV-CACHE), Bazel optimizations (P-LIT-BAZEL-DEPS), and other patterns that require matrix builds, scheduled runs, dependency installation, or longer-running jobs. None of these apply to this minimal, fast-running test workflow. The workflow already includes path-based trigger filtering. No evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow's characteristics.
